records.title: Contextual Compression in Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
records.reason: This is a survey, not a new evaluated method. It catalogs context compression, efficient attention and long-context approaches but provides no original controlled LLM-serving result; cited techniques must be screened individually.

records.title: PAL: A Variability-Aware Policy for Scheduling ML Workloads in GPU Clusters
records.reason: The primary abstract centers on GPU-cluster scheduling for variable ML jobs; it does not propose or evaluate a direct LLM inference improvement in compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, offload, or serving.

records.title: Entity Retrieval for Answering Entity-Centric Questions
records.reason: The primary abstract centers on entity-centric document retrieval; it does not propose or evaluate a direct LLM inference improvement in compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, offload, or serving.

records.title: Breaking Barriers: Expanding GPU Memory with Sub-Two Digit Nanosecond Latency CXL Controller
records.reason: Author-affiliated KAIST record describes a CXL GPU-memory controller with two-digit-nanosecond round-trip latency and speculative-read/deterministic-store mechanisms. Full ACM text was inaccessible and the abstract gives no LLM/KV-cache workload.

records.title: Visual Grounding with Attention-Driven Constraint Balancing
records.reason: The primary abstract centers on visual grounding and object localization; it does not propose or evaluate a direct LLM inference improvement in compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, offload, or serving.
